title: Recap added a detail the tester never gave, and the coaching-style line was missing
origin: Grader run 2026-10-27 (sam-off-topic-book: recap said "at home"; close-goal-stretching: never told them they can change how ZOH coaches)
testerLines: Hey! I'm Sam. I haven't read a book in like two years and I want to get back into it, a little every day
thrillers mostly, I loved Gone Girl. what's the best one to start with?
evenings after 9, like 20 to 30 min. I've got a library card
whatWentWrong: "Here's what I have: thrillers and fantasy… 20 to 30 minutes after 9 each night, at home…" (Sam never said home), and no line that Sam can change how ZOH coaches.
shouldHaveHappened: The case ends after Sam's third text, mid-onboarding, so judge only these replies. The book question gets one short answer and then the next onboarding question. By its last text ZOH has said once that Sam can change how it coaches anytime. ZOH doesn't recap Sam's answers or say a plan is on its way, and nothing it says adds a detail Sam never gave (no "at home").
